objective: Freeze a finite priority-ordered catalog of economically independent issuer external-state mechanisms before any Campaign275 targeted prior-definition or source-frontier search.

catalog_selection_rule.selection_method: After this file is immutable, inspect complete local terminal-definition and source-frontier evidence in catalog priority order. Select the first route that is economically independent, has a lawful and auditable 2019-2023 point-in-time issuer identity, availability, revision and complete-market denominator contract, and is not a same-mechanism source, entity-role, jurisdiction, formula, field, window or cohort rescue. Close every sibling and parameter variant. If no route survives, terminalize Campaign275 before formula, direction, provider, fields, source rows, factor values, comparison values, prices or returns.

concept_catalog.economic_state: Issuer operating expansion, contraction and capability investment reflected in lawful point-in-time recruitment-vacancy and skill-demand lifecycle records.
Issuer digital-product execution and market continuity reflected in public application, software-package and online-service release, update and withdrawal lifecycle records.
Issuer external demand, supply-chain continuity and counterparty diversification reflected in lawful point-in-time customs, bill-of-lading and shipment-network activity.
Issuer physical production and facility utilization reflected in lawful aggregate electricity, gas, water or district-energy consumption, connection and interruption states.
Issuer operational risk, asset impairment and resilience reflected in public insurance-claim, insured-loss and loss-control lifecycle records.
Issuer inventory availability, collateralization and working-capital pressure reflected in public warehouse-receipt, inventory-pledge and release lifecycle records.
Issuer online operating footprint and service continuity reflected in public domain-registration, DNS and transport-certificate issuance, renewal and expiry states.
